cohort_rule: Three predeclared Abbott cardiovascular products from P100009, P230007 and P240042; patent universe is the union of U.S. patents listed under those product sections on Abbott's public patent disclosure page.
eligible_queries: All three selected devices with at least one disclosed product-level patent relationship; reference-empty queries would be excluded as unjudged, never negative.
universe_rule: Deduplicated canonical U.S. publication/grant IDs resolved from public patent pages; preserve the Abbott raw number and page-derived kind code.

methods.HT-B0a: Company/metadata-only control using source-backed Abbott applicant/disclosure metadata with deterministic ID tie-break.
methods.HT-B0b: Deterministic BM25 over normalized patent title, abstract and claims text.
methods.HT-B1: Fixed BM25 plus all-MiniLM-L6-v2 dense retrieval, reciprocal-rank fusion, and cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2 reranking over the same frozen candidate pool.
methods.HT-B2: Fixed schedule of technical description plus declared PMA generic-name/product-code features using the same dense retriever, fusion and reranker as HT-B1.
methods.HT-B3: Observable heuristic: continue from the technical query to the next fixed feature only when first-pass new-candidate yield or lexical/dense disagreement indicates unresolved search state; never reads references.

retrieval.document_text: title + abstract + claims in source order, tokenizer truncation is fixed at 256 tokens
retrieval.tie_break: descending score then canonical patent ID

models.license: Apache-2.0 model-card declarations; weights remain local-only

failure_and_cost_rules.missing_or_failed_query: score zero while remaining in the eligible denominator
failure_and_cost_rules.unknown_prediction_id: retains rank position and cannot count as a hit
failure_and_cost_rules.monetary_cost: paid_cost_usd=0 because no provider action is dispatched; this is not an estimate of future spend

groups_and_splits.exact_patent_groups: Connected components over shared disclosed canonical patent IDs
groups_and_splits.family_groups: No family join without independent source; absence is unknown, not independence
groups_and_splits.company_groups: Report all-Abbott sensitivity; company-held-out is not estimable
groups_and_splits.split: Development only for all three queries; no final holdout or generalization claim

diagnostics.explicit_patent_ids: Count and mask patent-like tokens in runtime device text before scoring; disclosure references are never runtime inputs
diagnostics.company_shortcut: Report metadata-only control and company overlap explicitly
diagnostics.leakage: Runtime payload rejects references, gold, split answers, family labels and disclosed_by fields

limitations: This cohort is a public product-level disclosure development setting, not Bridge gold and not component-level expert judgment.
All devices share one applicant and one disclosure source; independent-group uncertainty is small.
The model cards describe general web/MS MARCO training; medical-device patent adequacy is not established.
No final held-out evaluation, adaptive LLM run, clinical/FTO assessment, production readiness or publication claim is made.
